notes: Programme-specific pages say non-EU applicants apply via the university's own online application ("Online Application June 1 - July 15 ... October 15 (German/EU applicants only)"), and no quote mentions uni-assist or a VPD, so applicationChannel is de-university-direct. Tuition 0 EUR/semester is evidenced only on the DAAD page for this programme ("Tuition fees per semester None"). Required documents are only those explicitly listed on the SEPP application page; translation is required only for the secondary school certificate and transcripts ("in English or German").
